## 席位核对 — REWORK · L1 · head `0a2eaf12387a3c42e1ffe5d06dfa0a002ec2c71a` · 2026-11-25T05:54Z

L1 for card #36906 (Studio 3-4: dashboards and reports open in the app's edit state; report New goes to the app's new-report page). It reads the os-dev report 7153618697 and the zone note 7154065677.

- **Review method:** read-only. Nothing was built or run at the seat.
- **Size:** 33 files, +1,223/−42. Not governed and not Tier H, so this self-lands after ACCEPT.

**What holds on reading:**
- **Done-when 1:** the item open is wrapped in `StudioAreaAppGate` (`StudioMetadataArea.tsx:154`). It replaces the Studio address and carries the arrival.
- **Done-when 2 (decision 6):** `studioAppEditSegment` is now shared with `studioBackTarget`. Pins: `studioAppEdit.test` rule by rule, plus the area cases for the remembered package app, another app whose menu opens the item, and Setup with no such menu landing in the package's app.
- **Done-when 3 (decision 15):** `?studio=` is built and read only in `studioAddress.ts`, with the same-origin refusals pinned. × survives a reload on the dashboard page and the report page (both pinned).
- **Done-when 4 (decision 13):** routing is pinned in `StudioAreaAppOpen-36906`. Where the report is saved is wrong: see M1.
- **Acceptance checks:** the design-mode exclusion reached from Studio is pinned in `ReportView.designModeExclusion-36692`. The phone gate is pinned, with the dev's ablation.
- **Red on revert:** judged by reading, every pin above goes red when its hunk is reverted.
- **Seat directions, both declared in the PR body** (seat edit at 2026-11-25T05:48Z):
  - (1) The `.custom` pair case points to follow-up #37237, which is open.
  - (2) Reload: × survives, the editor does not reopen, kept as shipped.
- **Dev's third question (where × sits):** A, right-aligned, accepted. Decision 15 fixes no position, so no new header slot is needed.
- **Old addresses and bookmarks:**
  - `…/metadata/{dashboard,report}/X/history`, `?review=1` and the `~all` leg keep the generic item page (pinned).
  - Old Interfaces URLs still land on the Studio home with the notice (unchanged).
  - A read-only base's own rows open in the base's app. Pair rows stay on the generic page until #37237.
- **i18n: clean.** The PR only adds `studioReturn.{close,closeLabel,leaveConfirm}` in all 11 locales, and removes nothing. No 18.6.0 key is touched, so rulings 7153171432 / 7153326968 do not apply.
- **Docs:** `plugin-dashboard.mdx`: all five added sentences are true at this head.

### Open

- M1 (must-fix) — A report made from Studio's report list is no longer saved in the package.
  - **Before this PR:** the area's own create saved into the package (`?package=P`). On a read-only base it saved into the base's `.custom` pair (`AreaPairedCreate`). Where the pair door is closed, it did not create at all.
  - **Now:** New opens `/apps/APP/reports/new`, and `ReportNewPage` saves through `saveAndPublishRuntimeMetadata`. That function gives a package only to views (`runtime-metadata-persistence.ts:574`: `const app = type === 'view' ? ctx.app : null`), so the report is written with no package and becomes environment metadata (ADR-0146 D11).
  - **The effect:** Studio's list keeps only the package's and its pair's rows (`scopeListRows`, `metadataListState.ts:273-280`). The report the author just made is missing from the list × returns to, on writable packages and read-only bases alike.
  - **Why the walk missed it:** the live walk checked the landing and the × only. The dev's "installed app, unmeasured" note is this same defect, and it can be settled by reading.
  - **Fix:** give the new-report save the app's package, as views get it (`resolveRuntimeCreatePackage`: the package when writable, else its pair through the ensure door).
  - **Pins:**
    - a report saved from `/apps/APP/reports/new?studio=…` names `packageId: P`;
    - on a read-only base it names the pair;
    - CONTROL: a refusing ensure door falls back as views do.
  - **Then:** reword 速读 bullet 3 (S3).
- M2 (must-fix) — A dashboard or report with no published version opens in the app on 「not found」.
  - **The cause:** the gate sends every plain open to the app. Outside draft preview, the app reads only published metadata (`DashboardView.tsx:208-237`, `ReportView.tsx:143-146`).
  - **Who hits it:** a row in Studio's list that exists only as a draft, such as an AI draft or a create whose publish was refused. It now lands on 「Dashboard not found」 or 「Report not found」 instead of the generic page that opened the draft.
  - **Related path, not measured:** Studio's dashboard New is still the area's own create. Its Save publishes, then navigates to the item (`ResourceEditPage.tsx:2265`), and the gate forwards that to the app.
    - Nothing shows that the app already serves the just-published dashboard.
    - History there is list → new → app, so Back from a miss lands on an empty create page.
  - **Fix:** keep the generic item page when the item has no published version (one read in `StudioAreaAppOpen`, or the list row's draft mark).
  - **Pins:** a draft-only dashboard row keeps the item page; Studio's dashboard New → Save lands on the app's dashboard. Cover the second in a unit test or the walk.
- S1 (should-fix) — The new-report page's × over unsaved edits is not pinned. `ReportNewPage.tsx:108-117` asks before leaving, but only the clean × and Save are tested. Add: × over an edit asks; declining stays with nothing sent; agreeing goes back to the Studio list. Check: removing the `dirty &&` ask turns it red.
- S2 (should-fix) — The changeset uses internal wording. `?studio=`, `STUDIO_RETURN_PARAM` (a symbol of the private app-shell package), `/apps/APP/reports/new`, "Tailwind's `sm`" and "reserved console param" go into the CHANGELOG. This is the class of #37108 S4, #37168 S6 and #37169 S6. Say it in user terms: "the app's New report page", "a phone-width window", "the page's address remembers the Studio list".
- S3 (should-fix) — 维护者速读 bullet 3 is wrong at this head.
  - 「出错只影响打开到哪里，不改任何数据」 is false while M1 stands, and it stays a data-placement change after the fix.
  - It is also silent that an installed app's customizations keep the old Studio page until the follow-up.
  - Reword it in plain Chinese, with no bare card number.
- S4 (should-fix) — The report builder's × outside Studio still drops unsaved edits without asking.
  - The PR now passes `dirty` into that close handler (`ReportView.tsx:548-558`) but asks only on the Studio leg. The non-Studio leg (`handleCloseBuilder`, `:470`) closes silently.
  - The dev noted this and did not file it. Because the handler is touched here, ask on both legs, with one pin.
- S5 (should-fix) — No test drives a read-only base through the gate. This is the #37089 class. Add area cases with `readOnly` and `customization`:
  - a base dashboard row opens in the base's app;
  - a pair-row address (`/studio/BASE.custom/metadata/dashboard/X?package=BASE.custom`) keeps the generic page, which pins #37237's starting point;
  - report New on the base lands where M1 says (the pair), and goes back to the list when the pair door is closed.
- N1 — HotCRM leg and card item 5 live: NOT MEASURED (no HotCRM checkout). They carry to #36910 under the 7147006586 precedent, and the seat posts the carried-leg note with the ACCEPT. On that basis `Fixes #36906` stands.
- N2 — Declare which version the app shows when an item has a pending Studio draft over a published one. By reading, it shows the published version, and the in-page Save then meets the pending draft.
- N3 — Stray double blank line at `StudioAreaAppOpen.tsx:131-132`.
- N4 — The zone note's 52/10 of 62 predates the 2026-11-25T05:48Z body edit. Its re-runs of "PR-body guards" and "Check Changeset" both pass.

### Gates

- **Check-runs at head:** 66 runs: 54 success, 12 expected skip, 0 failed, 0 pending. Two of the successes are the body-edit re-runs. Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check both succeeded.
- **Declarations:**
  - `Clause-②: no` holds: `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true`, and the `@object-ui/i18n` change is additive only.
  - `Metadata-protocol: none` holds: no spec or protocol change.
  - `Skills-docs:` is not owed.
  - The two patch bumps are right.
- **Staleness:** K = 11, not stale. Main since the merge base (#37089 among it) shares 14 files with this PR, and `merge-tree` with `origin/main` is clean.
- **Overlap (`merge-tree` with this head, all clean):**
  - #37168 and #37169 share `StudioMetadataArea.tsx` and `studioAddress.ts` / `.test.ts`. In both merged trees `AreaItem` still wraps the open in the gate.
  - #37166 shares `studioAddress.test.ts` and `en.ts`.
  - #37232 and #37185 share no file. The new reads go through `useMetadataClient`, with no raw `fetch`, so #37185's bearer ratchet is not affected.
- **L2:** none owed. There is no contract face: no spec or protocol change, no published API, and i18n is additive. `?studio=` is a console-internal param of a private package, and its same-origin reader is pinned.

Next: one patch round for M1–M2, S1–S5 and the nits. Then the seat reads the delta and self-lands (not Tier H).
